newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico brokerage raises GDP view after Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Mexico brokerage raises GDP view after Q2 results.

text.p: Mexican corporate results for the second quarter show the economy is growing faster than expected, the Interacciones brokerage said on Monday.
As a result, the firm raised its estimate of second-quarter GDP growth to 6.3 percent from 5.5 percent, it said in a statement. It also raised its 1997 forecast to 5.0 percent from 4.8 percent.

"If analysts' estimates do not incorporate this good news, it is very likely the second-quarter GDP figures will be seen as better than expected," and that could be used to justify new gains on the bolsa, Interacciones said.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9565))
